PULL 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Lats, Shoulders, Triceps
SECONDARY
Core, Glutes, Quads

Instructions

Preparation: Push off the wall in a long, flat line. Swim an easy length first to settle your breathing.

1

Reach long and catch the water.

2

Pull under your body, elbow high.

3

Roll and breathe as the arm enters.

4

Catch with the other arm, face down.

5

Pull through; keep your hips high.

6

Enter fingertips first; kick small and steady.
